Commentary.Commentary: So, we have the two finalists, Ireland will face United Arab Emirates in the finals. The red-letter day will be on 24th February at 3:30 pm IST (10 am GMT). But as always the build up will begin much in advance. Do join us for the same. Till then, Adios.

Andy McBrine is the Player of the Match. He says that he feels good to be able to contribute to the team. Tells that it is all about confidence and playing your best cricket. Says that he played with freedom and stayed positive and played his shots.

Andy Balbirnie, the victorious skipper of Ireland says that the team was very motivated and determined to win. Adds that Gareth Delany played really well and his partnership with Harry Tector was crucial. Tells that they both came out and fired from ball 1. Mentions that they have loved the competition and are looking forward to play the finals.

Zeeshan Maqsood, the skipper of Oman, says that it was a bad day and a bad performance from the players. Mentions that this is past now and they need to rebuild and play well in the future. Adds that they were in the game till the 11th over but had a collapse and that turned the match.
Stay tuned for the presentation ....

Oman never gave a fight, the 40-run partnership between Shoaib Khan and Zeeshan Maqsood was the best they managed. Other than that, no one gave any fight. A disappointing performance from Oman and they know it too.

It was the bowlers who put on the show for Ireland. 165 was not that big a target but the bowlers stepped up to the occasion and took wickets at regular intervals. There was only one partnership that look threatening but it was broken by Josh Little. His 11th over was a successful one with two wickets in that and that changed the momentum completely. Other than that, it was a pretty easy day for Ireland.

Ireland are into the finals. What a run they are having. After that error start against UAE, they have found the rhythm and are now one step away from winning the finals. Meanwhile, United Arab Emirates have won their semi final match against Nepal so we have our finalists. Ireland will take on United Arab Emirates in the crunching finale. Both have qualified for the ICC T20 World Cup 2022 which will happen in Australia.

OUT! TAKEN! Simi Singh finishes the proceedings. Bowls it short, on middle. Fayyaz Butt gets down on one knee and slogs is to long on. Mark Adair there runs to his left and holds onto that near the ropes. Oman have been bundled out for 109. Ireland win by 56 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Simi Singh

OUT! CAUGHT! Andy McBrine bags his second wicket. Full and on off, Kaleemullah tries to go for another biggie. He smashes it to long on. The ball does not have enough legs to clear the ropes and Mark Adair completes the catch easily.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Smoked! Short and on off, Kaleemullah stands tall and hammers it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Short and on middle, pulled over mid-wicket for a brace.
Kaleemullah is in now.

OUT! STUMPED! Tosses it up nicely, on off, turning away. Aamir Kaleem is forced to draw forward and play. He does so trying to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge. Lorcan Tucker is quick to whip the bails off. He appeals to square leg umpire and he signals out as Aamir Kaleem was out of his crease. Ireland inching closer to the victory now.
Commentary.Howout: st Lorcan Tucker b Andy McBrine

Commentary.Commentary: Floats it up, on middle. Fayyaz Butt works it to long on for a single.
Short on middle, pulled to short fine leg. 78 needed in 30 balls.

Fayyaz Butt walks out to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! TAKEN! Ireland have got the big wicket and with this they have one leg in the finals. Short of a length, outside off. Maqsood opens the bat face and tries to play it late but he does so uppishly and towards short third man where Simi Singh takes it low. Craig Young is on a hat-trick.
Commentary.Howout: c Simi Singh b Craig Young

Commentary.Commentary: Aamir Kaleem walks out to bat.

Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little
